name: Project Lens
description: A heads-up display for everything you are building. Finds your projects, then shows what each is written in, what state git is in, what it depends on, what you left a TODO about and what you touched this week. Opens straight onto a project if Mavis names one.

project.description: The name of the project the user mentioned, if they named one. Leave it out if they just asked to see their projects.
